<p class="docs-lead">GenoDisc is an open-source Snakemake pipeline for post-GWAS functional genomics. Starting from GWAS summary statistics, it runs a standardised battery of analyses — fine-mapping, gene-level and transcriptome/proteome-wide association, heritability, and drug-target enrichment — to prioritise the genes, mechanisms, and candidate drugs behind an association signal.</p>

<div class="row card-row">
<div class="col-sm-6">
<div class="card">
<h2>Web platform</h2>
<p>Upload summary statistics in your browser. Analyses run on King's College London servers and results open in an interactive viewer. No installation needed.</p>
<a href="https://genodisc.er.kcl.ac.uk" class="button" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open the web platform ↗</a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-sm-6">
<div class="card">
<h2>Run the pipeline yourself</h2>
<p>Install the open-source Snakemake pipeline on your own machine or HPC. Choose this if your data can't leave your environment, or you need custom references, configuration or batch runs.</p>
<a href="pipeline_guide.html" class="button">Read the pipeline docs</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
